remarks:
Welcome home to this inviting 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath split-level home offering plenty of natural light, generous living spaces, and tons of storage throughout. The spacious living room features a cozy gas fireplace and flows nicely into the generously sized dining room, creating a comfortable space for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers an abundance of cabinetry and plenty of prep space for those who love to cook. All three bedrooms are nicely sized, complemented by a full bath with convenient access to the main living areas.

Step down from the kitchen to the next level, where you'll find a convenient wash room with a door leading directly to the patio. Enjoy your morning coffee, curl up with a good book, or simply relax in this private outdoor space. A one-car garage provides additional convenience, and just beyond the garage is a pleasant sunroom with access to the driveway—an ideal spot to enjoy the changing seasons. Basement host a nice recreation/family room with a wet bar.  Laundry room.  New roof.

Located close to downtown and all its amenities, this home offers comfortable living with plenty of space, storage, and versatility.
